reason: Article 10 establishes the general obligation for high-risk AI systems to ensure data governance, including data quality and minimisation. This provides a relevant legal basis for restricting sensitive inputs, but it is a high-level requirement and does not specifically mandate classification, masking, or the technical controls mentioned.

Article 26(4) requires that high-risk AI systems process personal data in a manner that is limited to what is necessary for the intended purpose. This supports the 'minimisation' aspect of the control but does not address classification or masking of sensitive inputs.
Article 27 pertains to the documentation and record-keeping obligations for high-risk AI systems. It does not address the technical restriction or processing of sensitive inputs.
